findings.entity: ground/terrain between camera and skater (deck vs. bowl)
findings.description: From 7.5-8.0s the skater rides toward the camera on flat deck, with no coping or bowl edge between them. Bowls show only far off at the horizon on the left. Between 8.0 and 8.25s, while the heading stays about the same (lamp masts on the left, tree line on the right), a deep tiled bowl with steel coping appears just in front of the camera. The skater is now airborne over it and lands on the bowl transition at 9.5s. Where the skater had just been rolling on flat ground is now a bowl, and the coping appears with no earlier sign of it in front of the camera. This reads as the terrain layout changing, not the camera revealing hidden geometry.
